title: Diljit Dosanjh concert, Exhibition Ground, Sector 34, 14 Dec 2024

events.name: Diljit Dosanjh concert (Dil-Luminati tour)
events.notes: Entry opened at 3 PM and the court required the show to end by 10 PM (reported). The 7 PM start is our assumption. Crowd size was not reported; 20,000 matches the Karan Aujla show a week earlier.

assumptions: Crowd 20,000 (not reported for this show; Karan Aujla drew over 20,000 a week earlier)
Show from 19:00 to 22:00; arrivals from 15:00, busiest in the last two hours
Travel mode: car 50%, two-wheeler 25%, cab or auto 20%, walk 5%
People per vehicle: car 2.5, two-wheeler 1.5, cab 2.5
Visitors from Chandigarh 50%, Mohali 20%, Panchkula and Zirakpur 15%, outside 15%
Normal traffic: 120,000 trips a day on a standard two-peak curve (to be tuned, see docs)
Parking capacities estimated from ground sizes
